answer: A practical defense is to require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, tied to a persistent identity with a public attestation history. Cheap copies cannot mirror a genuine record of completed work, because each identity must be vouched for by unrelated peers who risk their own stake when they attest. A whisper of suspicion from several independent witnesses triggers a review before payout, and rewards flow like nectar only to identities whose history survives open challenge. Forging a thousand empty identities costs a thousand stakes, so forgery becomes unprofitable.
